title: S01 CAPTURE lane: the front door, photographed
_comment: Section H/G evidence split, owner decision 2026-08-27, recorded in ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md section H.1. This is the CAPTURE lane for S01: it takes the prescribed section G frame at the named state, rather than recording continuously through the segment. S01 runs the same opening headless for its mechanics and telemetry and hands this id here.
_comment_why_this_is_the_same_evidence: GF-01-TITLE-01's named state is 'title screen fully loaded, S01' and the production path to it is a wiped user:// and a boot. That is what this segment does, step for step, from the same fresh save S01-02 makes -- so the frame is of the same state S01 photographed on 2026-08-27 (1920x1080, mean luma 50.8, spread 32.4, 5.4% dark), taken from the same production path, at a cost of a boot and a handful of frames rather than of the segment. Section 0.6 is satisfied: free_build off, no teleport, no granted items, no debug state.
_comment_states_a_save_cannot_restore: Not every section G frame is reachable this cheaply. A title screen needs only a boot; a mid-dialogue or mid-fight frame is not a saveable state and its capture lane has to be seeded from the logic lane's nearest save (seed_save + boot + await_load) and then staged forward by a short scripted approach. That is still seconds of play per frame instead of hours, and it is the authoring pattern the remaining segments' capture lanes follow.
